_comment: 'The next attack action card you play this turn GAINS "When you attack with this, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero"' -- a whole triggered ability granted to ONE card. The queues carried keywords, power and classes, all values; this needed the ability itself, so grants now attach to Card.granted_abilities and dispatch fires them alongside the card's own. Injecting a turn-scoped trigger instead would fire for EVERY attack that turn. The fused branch (+1{p}) is not modelled: fusion state is not tracked.
